title: Nvidia's Record Quarter, Claude Cowork Gets a Browser & Salesforce Debuts Claudeforce
tldr: Nvidia posted $96.2B in quarterly revenue (+106% YoY) — Jensen Huang calls it an AI industry "inflection point."
Claude Cowork can now browse the web itself in a side panel, and Salesforce's earnings-fueled "Claudeforce" brings 37 Claude skills into its platform.
Try the Grok Bot playbook below to delegate meeting prep, prospecting, and follow-ups to a team of purpose-built AI "Bots."

tips.heading: Build an AI "GTM Team" with Grok Bot
steps: Download the Grok Bot desktop app and sign in.
Go to Plugins and connect tools like Gmail, Drive, Slack, Salesforce, and Granola.
Click "+" → Create new Bot, describing its role and workflow in plain language — start with a Chief of Staff Bot for meetings, emails, and follow-ups.
Spin up more Bots for prospecting, forecasting, or sales coaching, and give each a clear name so they're easy to find in the sidebar.
tips.prompt: Manage my meeting prep, inbox, and follow-ups. Keep updates concise and draft responses in my writing style without sending them.

news.body: Nvidia posted $96.2B in quarterly revenue, up 106% YoY — roughly $1B a day — with CEO Jensen Huang calling it an AI industry "inflection point."
news.means: Enterprise AI infrastructure spend shows no sign of slowing — a useful data point for budget conversations with clients weighing their own AI infra investment.

news.body: Anthropic's Claude Cowork can now open its own web browser as a side panel inside chats to search and gather information, rolling out to paid desktop plans over the next week.
news.means: Worth piloting for research-heavy workstreams — an agent that browses live while you supervise closes a real gap versus static chat answers.

news.body: Salesforce reported $11.3B in quarterly revenue (+11% YoY), sending its stock up 20%, and debuted "Claudeforce" — a Salesforce/Anthropic integration bringing 37 pre-built skills into Claude chats.
news.means: If clients run Salesforce, this is a concrete new AI entry point to raise in scoping conversations — model providers are now integrating directly into major SaaS platforms.

news.body: AI demand is pushing device prices up — Nvidia plans to raise prices starting in 2027, and Apple's refreshed Mac mini (built for on-device AI workflows) costs more than its predecessor.
news.means: A minor budgeting flag for teams planning hardware refreshes around on-device AI capability.
